notes: The two el phrases are rendered differently: the first takes the bare because of the recast infinitive clause (rule 52), the second because of before a nominal.
The two segments of Ichabod are one unit for the single transliterated word, headed on the first-standing morpheme (rules 30 and 23); the marginal note on the name is read and set aside (rule 38).
The le of lemor is unrepresented (rule 27), and the la on na'ar is unrepresented because the ASV writes a bare object (rule 40).
